items.headline: Converse makes a waterproof hairy-suede Chuck 70
items.caption: The Chuck 70 GORE-TEX keeps the classic look but keeps out water.
body: Fuzzy suede uppers, waterproof inside.
A winter Chuck you'll actually wear.
How to wear it: with cuffed jeans and a parka.

items.headline: Evisu's Y2K denim has grown up
items.caption: The Japanese denim giant is evolving, its brand director says.
body: Evisu was once the loudest name in rap fashion.
Now it's getting more refined.
How to wear it: one statement pair, plain tee.

items.headline: The OG 'Space Jam' Air Jordan 11 returns
items.caption: Jordan Brand revives the classic for the film's 30th anniversary in December.
body: It marks the movie's 30th anniversary.
The original still beats the remakes.
How to wear it: black tracksuit, nothing else loud.

items.headline: Nike's quilted Air Force 1s look like a Chanel bag
items.caption: Diamond-stitched black leather covers the upper.
body: Only the Swoosh and heel are smooth.
Luxury handbag energy, for your feet.
How to wear it: with black tailoring.

items.headline: Fear of God's first in-house sneaker
items.caption: Jerry Lorenzo's label remixes his greatest hits a year after leaving Adidas.
body: Fear of God is known for neutral colours and boxy shapes.
Now it makes its own trainers.
How to wear it: with oversized sweats.

items.headline: Robert Pattinson could be the most fashion-forward Bond
items.caption: A Dior ambassador and one of Hollywood's most interesting dressers.
body: Connery had Savile Row; Moore had safari jackets.
Pattinson could bring something new.
Style lesson: classic cuts, unusual details.

items.headline: The 5 types of coats every guy should own
items.caption: An expert's guide to building winter outerwear.
body: 'Your coat is your car,' one menswear friend says.
Cover the basics, then have fun.
How to wear it: a topcoat over tailoring, a parka for weekends.

items.headline: Jonathan Bailey's Burberry hat and scarf
items.caption: A collab sold through his Shameless Fund charity.
body: Bailey is one of Britain's brightest stars.
Good gifts that do good.
How to wear it: check scarf with a navy coat.

items.headline: Vinnie Hacker says goodbye to skinny jeans
items.caption: The TikTok star on sudden fame and his style's next step.
body: He spoke at Burberry's Christmas takeover in New York.
He went viral in 2020.
Style lesson: relaxed fits are in.

items.headline: Bangalore Watch Company goes dressy with the Epoch
items.caption: The Indian brand turns from tool watches to a dress watch.
body: Hodinkee has live pictures.
A home-grown name on a global watch site.
Style lesson: a slim dress watch suits a kurta or a suit.

items.headline: A Ferdinand Berthoud one-off, eight years in the making
items.caption: A look at the unique Chronomètre FB 1R5-5.
body: Ferdinand Berthoud is staking its place in modern watchmaking.
One of one.
Style lesson: patience makes the best things.

items.headline: Indian family turns rhino dung into paper
items.caption: Elrhino's notebooks give villagers income and a reason to protect rhinos.
body: Co-founded by Mahesh Chandra Bora and his daughter.
Locals collect the dung.

items.headline: Town replaces a teen's stolen landscaping gear
items.caption: Neighbours raised money after $20,000 of equipment was stolen.
body: Sonny Gallardo started raking leaves in 6th grade.
Now he runs Sunnyside Jobs.

items.headline: A chef cooks for 100 people every Tuesday from food-bank finds
items.caption: Toronto chef Maddy Goldberg turns random donations into banquets.
body: She's done it for years.
Her videos have a big following.
